{{Top|leg}}
'''The Headquarters''' was an underwater [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located on the lower levels of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Alien Protection Zone/Legends|Invisible Sector]]. Its symbol was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] helmet, with a head inside it, being split into four pieces.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref>

Prior to the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Seizure of Coruscant]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] went in there for a drink and saw fellow Rogue [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] talking to the [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Lai Nootka]], whom he mistook for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Kirtan Loor]]. While trying to verify this, Horn was attacked by [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] member [[Zekka Thyne]] and a group of thugs who tried to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him. He managed to escape by appropriating a [[Zoom II speeder bike]] from a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] bystander.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble" />
